resources.string: Scenario management opens directly, with a separate screen for each parameter and current values in the menu.
Enable custom values from the title bar. Automatic fields stay visible in grey, with clearer descriptions.
Include automatic values when exporting to share a complete scenario of the current moment without changing your app settings.
New Origin and Pointing filters join Type and Visibility, with result counts and saved preferences.
Category backgrounds match in the object list and Type filter, in both light and dark themes.
Filter fields are more compact and consistent. Scenario files remain compatible and retain the resumption options.
